note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the za-cct-001 worker artifact 9f2e10ce485635f65e695072e2bbd904024ebf58b1465d12fb969f8bb0692180 (gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact, failed_checks empty, exact-byte --accept on the worker and re-accept in za-cct-baseline-001 before any score); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The prediction instant is 06:00 SAST on day D; every shipped feature reads only readings with timestamps <= the instant (including day D 00:00-06:00) and trailing aggregates from readings <= the instant; the evening target window 16:00-22:00 SAST lies entirely after the instant; the evening label matrix is sealed to auxiliary/evening_peaks.csv (artifact-side) and NO evening-derived column ships in any split file - the synthetic rehearsal pinned by tests/test_za_cct_build.py bounds the evening-p95 delta attack at 0.995 exact agreement, and the gate's real-artifact probe measured the shipped morning-peak history column at 44.9% eval mismatches (no recovery). The publisher released the window as ONE CLOSED TABLE (hasStaticData), so the evaluation contract is retrospective research: no historical-operational-availability claim is made. PACKAGING IS BY OPERATOR DECISION (a) RECORDED 2026-11-04 (agent-headroom benchmark, on the ocha-fts precedent), and the comparison LEADS every package document, README first: the stock runner baseline scored eval AUC 0.5107 (both runner implementations agree, on the accepted bytes after --accept) on the identical 14,965 eval rows, while the pre-registered headroom reference morning_ratio (morning_max / hist_morningpeak_mean_90, reading only shipped at-instant columns - a fair same-information comparison) reached 0.7340, with persistence_prev_evening 0.6502 (information-asymmetric BY DESIGN: recomputed scorer-side from strictly-earlier same-station rows), calendar_identity 0.6504, identity_only 0.5134, month_only 0.6541, majority-class accuracy 0.9161, global_rate degenerate; paired clustered bootstrap (150 resamples, (station, day) clusters): morning_ratio over persistence CI [-0.1012, -0.0706] and over calendar_identity CI [-0.1019, -0.0627] exclude zero. NO figure may be quoted without that comparison beside it. The artifact's splits: train 13,735 rows / 1,539 positives (11.205%) / 227 distinct exceedance days (label year 2022), eval 14,965 / 1,256 (8.393%) / 246 days (2023), holdout 15,006 / 1,382 (9.210%) / 247 days (2024, sealed); burn-in 1,230 station-days counted, never scored.
